slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

the honest compliment

give one specific, honest compliment a day, out loud, to someone's face. people who notice the good in others are the ones everyone wants to be around.

finishing your sentences

for one week, don't let anyone finish your sentences for you. keep going calmly until you're done, and notice how quickly people start waiting for you.

talking topics

spend 5 minutes a day learning about one new topic: an artist, an invention, a moment in history. people who always have something to talk about never dread a silence.

slides.texte_overlay:
recording yourself

record yourself telling a short story once a week and listen back. you'll hear what to fix, and you'll also hear that you sound much better than you think.

one call a day

make one phone call a day you'd normally avoid: a booking, a question, a friend. the dread before the call is always bigger than the call itself, and it shrinks every time.
